title: MMD_materials_outline v0.1 draft
description: Independent outline on a glTF 2.0 material. Presence enables it. Defaults are annotations, applied by consumers on omission.

colorFactor.description: Finite source-component RGBA, unrestricted on input; clamped to [0,1] on evaluation. RGB is sRGB, alpha is linear opacity.

sizeFactor.description: Nonnegative finite material edge size. One unit displaces a vertex one framebuffer pixel when its edge scale is 1.
